game.name: Catapult Quest
game.rules:
## For All Runs

- Runs under 30 minutes are required to be timed in milliseconds.
- Timing is paused during all ads and lag spikes.
- BlueStacks and any virtual machine are the only emulators allowed for runs.
- Moderators are not allowed to verify their own submissions.
- *For runs 2024-12-23 and onward:* If you plan to submit several runs in the same video, that video cannot exceed 5 minutes. If it does, all your submissions will be rejected.

newsList.body: The ILs are now fixed! Runs can be verified again! Sorry for any inconvinience.
